description: This file is a shell script designed to test various Git filter and conversion functionalities, particularly in handling large files, line ending conversions, and custom filters. It sets up test cases to verify correct behavior of Git's attributes and filters, including large file handling, autocrlf, eol, ident, custom user filters, and handling of large files over 4GB.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Sets Git attributes for files, specifically creating or modifying the .gitattributes file with given attributes.

methods.name: check_input
methods.description: Verifies that input filters correctly process the files by comparing the content before and after filtering.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Verifies that output filters correctly process the files by comparing the filtered content with expected content.
